review_status: A09 reviewed optional extension evidence prepared on work/a09-extension-review; merge into main required before final paper citation.
approval_meaning: Sanitized E11-E12 summaries for the optional Kerberoasting-inspired mechanism demonstration. They illustrate bounded dictionary inclusion vs. exclusion under fixed local parameters and do not establish Active Directory cracking speed, Windows Event 4769 detection, or password uncrackability.
limitations: Kerberoasting-inspired local mechanism demo using AES-256-GCM and PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256, not Active Directory RC4 or RFC 3962 AES string-to-key.
Uses the bundled 5-word demonstration list (data/wordlists/demo.txt); non-recovery in E12 establishes only absence from this list within the 5-attempt budget, not uncrackability.
AES alone does not prevent offline guessing of weak passwords; acquisition and offline verification are kept separate, and no Windows Event 4769 detection is claimed.
